info.title: OpenReturn API
info.description:
REST API for IRS Form 990 filings, organizations, and financial-health / qualitative scores.

**Authentication** is optional per deployment: when the server runs with `--auth`, every route requires an API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` or `X-API-Key: <key>` (a 401 is returned otherwise, and a 429 if a per-key rate limit is exceeded).

**Errors**: validation and not-found conditions are returned as HTTP 200 with an `{"error": "..."}` body. 401/404/413/429/500 are produced by the server.

post.summary: Create a scoring model from a definition (user:admin)
post.description: Registers a model from a `{model, factor}` definition (e.g. a template, edited). `dry_run` validates without writing; `skip_existing` no-ops a duplicate version. Audited.

200.description: OK — the resource, or `{"error": …}` on an application error

200.description: OK — the resource, or `{"error": …}` on an application error

post.summary: Update (edit) an existing scoring model (user:admin)
post.description: Replaces a model's header + factors in place. The version is taken from the definition and can't change. `dry_run` validates only. Scores under the old definition go stale, so the result flags `recompute_needed`. Audited.

200.description: OK — the resource, or `{"error": …}` on an application error

post.summary: Archive (retire) or un-archive a scoring model (user:admin)
post.description: Sets the model's `archived` flag. Archiving excludes it from batch scoring + the pickers (reversible, keeps its scores); blocked if a live composite depends on it. `archived` defaults true; pass false to un-archive. Audited.

archived.description: true to archive (default), false to un-archive

200.description: OK — the resource, or `{"error": …}` on an application error

post.summary: Delete a scoring model (user:admin)
post.description: Hard-deletes a model. Blocked if another model references it (delete those first) OR if it has stored scores — archive it instead (this route never force-deletes scores). Audited.

200.description: OK — the resource, or `{"error": …}` on an application error

get.summary: List what has been grabbed and ingested
get.description: `grabbed` is the URL-ingest ledger (provenance + counts); `archives` summarizes every source ZIP seen in the filings (covers local-dir and uploaded archives). `ingest_running` reflects a live background ingest.

200.description: OK — the resource, or `{"error": …}` on an application error

post.summary: List the ZIP archives reachable at a URL (dry run)
post.description: Discovers `.zip` archives at a direct link or an index page (default: the IRS Form 990 downloads page) and flags which are already ingested. No downloads, no DB writes.

200.description: OK — the resource, or `{"error": …}` on an application error

post.summary: Start a background ingest from a URL
post.description: Launches a detached ingest of a `.zip` archive or index page. The job briefly restarts this API server to take the DB lock; refused under systemd or while another ingest runs. An optional `schedule` (`HH:MM`, `+2h`, or `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM`; omitted/`now` runs immediately) delays the start.

schedule.description: Delay the start: HH:MM, +2h, or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM. Omitted/empty/'now' runs immediately.

200.description: OK — the resource, or `{"error": …}` on an application error

county_fips.description: Deduced from the ZIP; null until counties imported

following.description: Whether the calling user follows this org (false for non-user callers)

updated_by.description: Actor who last edited the org

address.description: Physical address (the as-filed filer address), or null

Field.description: A reported field value with its 990 schema location.

imputed.description: True if an input was filled from another year

source_year.description: Donor year of a filled input, if any

imputed.description: True if any factor used a missing-data fallback

Template.description: A model-template catalog entry (a prefill guide).

code.description: Also the scoring model input key

FinancialFact.description: A (year, concept) with every source's observation, the chosen canonical value, and a conflict flag.

Membership.description: A person's link to an organization (with role and dates).

ModelKind.description: A model composition kind (model / composite / super_composite).

ScoreDebug.description: Read-only walkthrough of a model evaluation against a filing (formula, substituted numbers, variables + source, normalization).

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid API key (only when the server runs with --auth).

RateLimited.description: Per-key rate limit exceeded; a `Retry-After` header is sent.
